name: deck-design
description: Build slide decks that survive critic review. Bundles four skills: deck-mindset (fixed-role color vocabulary with a palette per background, dark or light + 15pt floor + 3-tier hierarchy + 5 named layouts + 8 card families, plus template profiles — aurora-black for the AWS black master, light for a plain white background — with dated lessons and two case studies), deck-build (token module, pptxgenjs/python-pptx build patterns and a validate → render → inspect QA loop, with Korean-deck specifics: Latin in Amazon Ember, Korean in Noto Sans CJK KR, or Apple SD Gothic Neo on a Mac — and a script that makes an existing deck animatable piece by piece), and deck-agent-team (Phase-2 review via parallel critic agents — visual + content + cognitive + compliance — with PASS/FAIL gate and human-checked patch apply), and deck-web (the same deck as one HTML file: aurora-black tokens on a 1280×720 canvas, click builds, speaker notes, an optional Korean/English toggle driven by one JSON map, a Chromium capture that flags overflow, and an S3 + CloudFront publish script). Use when designing, producing or auditing presentations that prioritize consistency and audience cognition over visual variety.
